title: FetchJWTSVID proves only silently-provable candidates
description: Constraint (1) of persona-jl4j.2, split out because it must land BEFORE any interactive prover: hire-grpc/src/service.rs proved every enumerated candidate on every request, so the first attestor able to raise pinentry or blink a FIDO2 key would have turned one RPC into a prompt storm. The gate tests for ProofCost::Silent -- the guarantee -- rather than against Interactive, so a future variant is skipped until someone decides otherwise. Interactive candidates are not unreachable; they are reached by asking (persona-ouo5.3). The rest of persona-jl4j.2 (the sorted, hint-tagged list of every silent identity) stays open and depends on persona-jl4j.1 and persona-5s4b.87.
acceptance_criteria: A candidate declaring Interactive never reaches prove() on the FetchJWTSVID path, demonstrated by a test that counts prove() calls.
close_reason: Landed in 84f6596 and 3b482e5; full workspace suite green, clippy and fmt clean.
